subject: Federated CoNodeMesh replication across explicit independent failure domains with typed node roles and no newest-wins collapse
contradictions: Current main already defines participant-owned CoNode identity/privacy/materialization; this delta preserves only federation, independent failure-domain, replica-role, divergence and replication-envelope relations.
tests: classify two copies in one provider/account as one provider failure domain
preserve divergent node states rather than newest-wins overwrite
prove replica role does not imply semantic authority
bind replication cursor and projection-loss metadata to a bounded object
expected_benefit: Extend CoNode participation into resilient multi-node custody/currentness without making copies, mirrors or reachable services authoritative.
risks: copy count may be mistaken for failure-domain diversity
replication may silently overwrite divergent relation state
node role proliferation may increase coordination debt
wake_conditions: independent private replica route becomes available
GRAIL lineage is recovered and can be reconciled exactly
a second receiver/failure-domain canary is ready
